It has been a while, Adventurer.
strings.그동안 이스트랜드의 고된 일을 해결하시고, 앞으로 나아가는 모습에 모두가: Everyone is grateful for the way you have resolved Eastland's difficult troubles and continued to move forward.
On behalf of everyone in Lumen, allow me to thank you again.
It was nothing. I only did what I had to...
That is why I called for you. There is something I must tell you.
Lady Iris is no longer in Lumen.
strings.가이아 님께서 부르셨다면서 며칠 전에 홀연히 떠나셨습니다. 아니, 정확히: She said Lady Gaia had called for her, then left without warning a few days ago. Or, more precisely, disappeared.
strings.확실히 전과는 다른 모습이셨죠. 그전까지는 인간 소녀이었지만, 격이 다른: She was certainly different from before. Until then, she had been a human girl, but now she seemed to exist on another level...
strings.(가이아 님께서 이리스를 만날 수 있다고 말씀하신 게 이거였나?): (Was this what Lady Gaia meant when she said I'd be able to meet Iris?)
strings.모험가님께서 얼마 전에 신탁을 받았다고 들었습니다. 실례가 되지 않는다면: I heard you recently received a divine revelation. If it isn't too forward of me, may I ask what it said?
strings.가이아 님께선 때가 되는 시간에 자신과 만날 사람을 찾고 계셨고, 그 시: Lady Gaia was looking for someone to meet her at the appointed time. I reached her then, so she blessed me.
And she said I would be able to meet Iris soon.
strings.어쩌면 모험가님께서 이리스 님과 만나는 것이 가이아 님이 정한 신탁일지도: Perhaps your meeting with Lady Iris is itself the divine revelation Lady Gaia ordained.
A divine revelation usually foretells fate through a god, but its meaning depends on how one interprets it.
strings.그러면 이제 이리스 님을 만나실 준비가 되셨습니까?: Then are you ready to meet Lady Iris?
Yes, of course. I'm always ready to meet her.
strings.그러시군요. 그러면 이리스 님이 가신 곳을 알려드리겠습니다. 이리스 님께: I see. Then I will tell you where she went. Lady Iris said you would understand once I told you.
She will be near the place where you received Lady Gaia's blessing...
I think I know where that is.
Then I hope you and Lady Iris have much to share.
Thank you for helping Iris all this time.
Not at all. I only did what I should.
strings.그러면 저는 이리스를 만나고 올게요. 아직 이스트랜드의 일이 끝나지 않았: Then I'll go see her. My work in Eastland isn't finished yet.
(Yuran watches until %s is out of sight beyond Lumen's alliance headquarters.)
Ull, you should have come out to say hello to %s.
When that person first came here, many people did not fully trust them.
strings.하지만, 여러 가지 위험한 일을 해결하고 모두에게 믿음을 주면서 없어서는: But by resolving dangerous problems and earning everyone's faith, the adventurer has become indispensable.
strings.너도 처음엔 %s 님을 무시했지만, 이젠 아닐 거야. 너도 느끼고 있을: You looked down on %s at first, but surely not anymore. You must feel it too.
As for becoming a Champion now...
strings.걱정하지 않으셔도 됩니다. 적이 아닌 아군을 일부러 죽이는 일을 할 수는: You needn't worry. I couldn't deliberately kill an ally instead of an enemy.
strings.그래, 알았어. 나는 이제 수련의 숲에 있는 길드를 살펴보러 갈 건데,: All right. I understand. I'm going to check on the guild in the Training Forest. Will you come?
strings.(적이라면 할 수도 있다는 말인가? 설마, 그건 아니겠지….): (Does he mean he could do it if they were an enemy? Surely not...)
strings.(맹약의 성소 뒤쪽의 작은 길, 그곳에서 알 수 없는 기운이 느껴진다.): (An unfamiliar energy comes from a narrow path behind the Sanctum of the Covenant.)
Is this it...? Similar to when I met Lady Gaia, but different in its nature...
Iris is waiting. Hurry. I'll finally be able to meet her.
strings.(%s의 시야에 가이아를 만났을 때와 같은 장소가 눈에 펼쳐진다. 분명: (The place where %s met Gaia unfolds before the adventurer. It is clearly the same place, yet the wind, sunlight, and even the atmosphere feel unfamiliar.)
It's the Sanctum of the Covenant, but it feels different. Different from when Lady Gaia was here...
strings.(입안에서 맴돌던 이름을 부르자 한 소녀의 모습이 그 안에서 나타난다.): (As the adventurer speaks the name lingering on their lips, a girl appears within.)
strings.(귀엽고 활발한 인상의 소녀가 모험가의 등장에 상기된 표정을 보인다.): (The girl, with her sweet, lively air, flushes at the adventurer's arrival.)
strings.(이리스가 손을 뻗어 %s를 붙잡는다. 그러다 다가가 살며시 다가가 안는: (Iris reaches out and takes hold of %s, then steps closer and gently embraces the adventurer.)
strings.무슨 말씀을 드려야 할지, 어떤 식으로 표현해야 할지 잘 모르겠어요. 그: I don't know what to say or how to express it. Except to thank you...
strings.(이리스가 맺힌 눈물을 닦으며 뒤로 물러난다.): (Iris wipes away her gathering tears and steps back.)
strings.저는 세레스 님의 뒤를 이어 성계신이 됐지만, 그래도 저는 인간…. 마음: I succeeded Lady Seres as the God of the Astral Realm, but I'm still human... I still have a human heart...
So as long as my power can reach you, as long as I have this heart, I'll act for you. And I'll be here for everyone who has cherished me.
strings.(이리스의 말이 끝나자마자 신비한 빛이 흘러나와 공간을 가득 채우기 시작: (As Iris finishes speaking, a mysterious light flows out and begins to fill the space.)
strings.(눈이 부셔 제대로 뜨지 못하고 있을 때, 이리스의 목소리가 들려온다.): (As the adventurer struggles to open their eyes against the radiance, Iris's voice reaches them.)
strings.(이리스를 감싸고 있던 빛이 물러나고 방금 전과 다른 모습의 이리스가 보: (The light around Iris recedes, revealing a different form from the one she wore a moment ago.)
strings.어떤 이야기를 할까요? 사실 얼굴 보고 이야기하는 건 처음이죠?: What should we talk about? This is actually our first time speaking face to face, isn't it?
You said you met me in the Poison Mist Swamp, but I wasn't myself then. I should have greeted you...
strings.(이리스가 장난기 어린 미소를 짓다가 약간 슬픈 표정을 보인다.): (Iris gives a playful smile, then looks a little sad.)
There's something I need to tell you.
strings.숨기려고 한 건 아닌데, 당신을 의심하게 만들었어요. 그것만으로 전 나쁜: I didn't mean to hide it, but I made you doubt. That alone makes me a bad person.
%s, at one point, you nearly became something you never wanted to be.
strings.원치 않는 존재가 뭐야?: Something I never wanted to be?
A being that could not help but sin...
strings.이 세계의 멸망을 바라는 존재가 저와 당신을 만나게 하기 전에 %s에게: Before you and I could meet, a being that desires this world's destruction placed a curse on you, %s.
strings.싫든 좋든 그 존재가 원하는 멸망의 기운을 접할 때마다 %s의 정신은 조: Whether you wanted it or not, every time you encountered the destructive energy that being sought, your mind was eroded a little more, %s.
That's why you sometimes felt unlike yourself, or acted that way.
strings.저는 당신을 지키고 싶었어요. 미약한 힘이지만, 당신을 위해 쓰고 싶었어: I wanted to protect you. My power was small, but I wanted to use it for you. To keep you from becoming that, %s, I erased your memories of those moments each time.
strings.…아, 그래서 내가 기억을…. 그리고 내가 때때로 내가 아닌 것 같이 행: ...Oh, so that's why my memories... And why I sometimes tried to act as though I weren't myself...
It was the only thing I could do before I awakened...
If the corruption had continued for too many days, %s, you could have become something you never wanted.
strings.누군가의 뜻대로 저를 비롯한 모두를 공격하는 그런 존재가 됐겠죠. 그래서: A being who attacked me and everyone else at someone else's command. That is why I asked Yuran to keep you from meeting me.
strings.미안해요. 제가 강했다면, 좀 더 강한 존재였다면 이렇게 %s 당신이 고: I'm sorry. If I had been strong, if I had been a stronger being, you wouldn't have had to suffer like this, %s...
strings.나는 괜찮아. 미안해하지 마. 이리스가 날 지켜준 거니까 괜찮아. 내가: I'm all right. Don't apologize. You protected me, Iris. It's all right. It was because I was weak...
strings.그래도 미안해요. 세레스 님을 기억하지 못하게 해서…. 이제는 제대로 기: Still, I'm sorry. For making you unable to remember Lady Seres... You should remember clearly now.
I remember that day in Xenadia clearly. I won't forget you either, Iris. I promise.
strings.초인들이 주신 힘의 흔적은 고대신의 것, 그 힘을 받아 저는 수련의 숲에: The traces of power the Champions gave us belong to the ancient gods. With that power, I no longer need to keep training in the Training Forest.
strings.저만의 모험가를 지킬 힘도 생겼어요. 그러니까 오해할 일도, 숨길 일도: I have the strength to protect my own adventurer now. So I won't give you reason to misunderstand, or hide things from you. I promise.
strings.그리고 모든 생명을 위해 저를 위해 힘써주신 가이아 님을 위해 위대한 벽: And for all living beings, and for Lady Gaia, who worked so hard for me, I will rebuild the Great Wall.
strings.세레스 님이 알려주신 세계의 진리와 가이아 님의 도움으로 좀 더 진실에: With the truths of the world Lady Seres taught me and Lady Gaia's help, I'm coming closer to the truth.
strings.그동안 정신으로 연결된 모험가님을 통해 데이모스의 정보를 얻었지만 부족해: I've learned about Deimos through our spiritual connection, Adventurer, but it still isn't enough.
It's all right. You can ask me for help.
strings.이미 내가 알고 있잖아. 내가 끝까지 해볼게. 그러니 이리스는 이리스의: I already know about it. I'll see it through to the end. So you see your own work through, Iris.
strings.그러면 초인의 힘이 더 필요한 거지?: Then you still need more of the Champions' power, right?
Only Lady Io and Lady Medea's powers remain...
strings.먼저 이오 님을 만나보세요. 지금 이오 님께서 모르는 일이 일어나고 있는: Please meet Lady Io first. Something seems to be happening that even she doesn't know about.
Thank you. You can meet me here whenever you like, so please come and see me.
strings.(이리스가 환하게 웃으며 손을 흔들며 웃는다. 그러자 이리스에게서 있었던: (Iris smiles brightly and waves. The light around her slowly approaches.)
strings.(이오 님이 계신 곳에 가려면 어느 쪽으로 가야 하지? 북쪽 설원이었던가: (Which way do I go to reach Lady Io? The northern snowfields...? Mars was nearby. I'll ask Peonia there.)
strings.(그런데 이리스의 말처럼 만약 내가 원치 않은 존재, 죄인처럼 변했다면: (But if I'd become something I never wanted, like a sinner, as Iris said... what would have happened?)
strings.(그렇게 이리스가 선사한 빛이 왔다 사라지고, 성역 에이도스 관문에서 눈: (Iris's light comes and goes. Opening their eyes at the Eidos checkpoint, the adventurer slowly sets off toward the next destination.)
strings.마르스에는 별 일 없었죠?: Has everything been all right in Mars?
strings.마르스는 별일이 없는데, 인근 설원에서 살짝 문제가 생겼어. %s, 데보: Mars is fine, but there's been a little trouble in the nearby snowfields. %s, do you know the Debora Snowfields?
strings.알고 있구나. 우물에서 나타난 악마와 몬스터 몇이 그쪽으로 갔는지 조금: So you know. A few demons and monsters from the well must have gone that way. There was a bit of a commotion.
strings.아직 게르다에서 따로 요청이 없는 걸 보니 그곳의 전사들이 잘 처리했나봐: Gerda hasn't asked for help, so its warriors must have handled it. I'm jealous...
When I look at Mars, where we can't feel safe without hiring fixers...
strings.아, 미안. 내 이야기만 했네. 그래서 무슨 일로 왔어?: Oh, sorry. Enough about me. What brings you here?
strings.이오 님을 만나러 게르다로 갈 건데, 정확히 어디로 가는지 몰라서 물어보: I'm going to Gerda to meet Lady Io, but I didn't know the exact route, so I came to ask.
strings.마르스가 북쪽이고, 데보라 설원도 북쪽이니 가깝지 않나요?: Mars is in the north, and so are the Debora Snowfields. They're close, aren't they?
strings.가깝긴 한데, 멀리 돌아가야 할 거야. 설원 쪽은 길이 험해서 잘 안 가: Close, yes, but you'll have to take a long way around. The snowfield route is so rough that people rarely use it, and the old path has disappeared.
strings.안쪽으로 쭉 가면 작은 길이 있어. 거기를 좀 돌아가면 될 거야. 저기,: Keep going deeper in and you'll find a narrow path. Follow it around. Oh, did you see Veled on your way here?
I was thinking about the snowfields and came straight to Mars, so I didn't pass by where he stays. Is something wrong with Veled?
strings.그 일 이후 며칠씩 사라지곤 했는데, 이번에도 그런 거 같아. 물어보면: Since that incident, he's been disappearing for days at a time. I think that's what's happening again. When I ask, he says he wandered around watching people.
I'm sure it's nothing. It had better be...
strings.요즘도 벨레드는 마을에 못 들어와요?: Is Veled still not allowed into town?
I'm trying to convince everyone, but I don't think Veled himself is ready yet.
strings.이런 이야기는 그만하고, 바쁜 것 같으니 가 봐. 가는 길에 방해가 될: Enough about that. You seem busy, so go on. And if any monsters get in your way, please deal with them.
I will. Thanks for your concern, Peonia. I'll be going.
...Whenever a god's messenger starts moving, I feel something big is about to happen...
strings.(조심하지 않으면 미끄러지거나 깊게 쌓인 눈 속으로 빠질 것만 같은 길이: (The path seems ready to send the unwary slipping or sinking into deep snow. The white landscape stretches endlessly ahead.)
Brr, it's cold. That wind cuts right through me. Whoa, I nearly fell...
strings.(하얀 설원 저 멀리 파란 색 물결이 흔들리는 걸 멍하니 보고 있어야 할: (Far beyond the white snowfields, blue waves seem to draw the adventurer's gaze. Chunks of ice floating on the sea rock with the water's movement.)
strings.이스트랜드에서 이런 풍경을 보게 될 줄이야…. 어, 그런데 이건 뭐지?: I never expected to see a view like this in Eastland... Huh, what's this? A sign? Let's read it.
strings.「여기는 데보라 설원입니다. 게르다 마을까지 가다가 위험하거나 추워서 얼: "Welcome to the Debora Snowfields. If the journey to Gerda becomes dangerous, or you feel you might freeze to death, be sure to stop for Titi halfway along and wave a carrot!"
Waving a carrot suddenly reminds me of Noel. Let's find that rest stop first.
strings.(설원 중심에 드물게 한 사람이 서 있다. 한 소년이 여우의 것처럼 보이: (A lone figure stands near the middle of the snowfields: a boy with ears like a fox's, twitching alertly.)
strings.(나무에 달린 당근을 흔들어보자.): (Let's wave the carrot hanging from the tree.)
strings.어…, 표지판을 보고 오신 분인가요?: Oh... Did you read the sign?
Yes. It said Titi would be here, and to wave a carrot.
strings.제가 바로 티티에요. 어서오세요. 여기서 쉬시면 금방 좋아질 거예요. 제: I'm Titi. Welcome. Rest here and you'll feel better soon. There's purifying energy around me, so you'll recover quickly.
strings.데보라 설원의 눈과 얼음은 잘 고르면 오염된 것도 금방 깨끗하게 만들 수: If you choose the right snow and ice from the Debora Snowfields, they can quickly cleanse even contaminated things. But you look familiar... No! Like someone I've heard a lot about.
strings.혹시 당신! 혹시 이오 누나를 만나러 가는 건가요?: Are you... Are you on your way to meet Io?
strings.네, 그렇긴 한데…. 이오 님한테 들은 건가요?: Yes, I am... Did Lady Io tell you?
strings.이오 누나가 그랬어요! 아는 언니한테 재미있게 생긴 사람이 언젠가 올 거: Io said an older friend told her that someone interesting-looking would come someday! Someone who looked like this and that.
She asked me to guide you if I saw you here.
strings.이래이래 저래저래 재미있게 생긴 사람…?: Someone interesting-looking, like this and that...?
strings.(이오 님의 아는 언니? 재미있게 생긴 사람? 샤이닉 님한테 들은 거면: (Lady Io's older friend? Interesting-looking? If she heard it from Lady Shynic, that must mean me...)
strings.이스트랜드에 바람처럼 나타나 데이모스 교단을 멋지게 상대하는 영웅이라고: I heard you're the hero who appeared in Eastland like the wind and took on the Deimos cult so bravely.
strings.(티티에게 간단한 소개를 한다.): (The adventurer briefly introduces themself to Titi.)
Feeling better now? You should be warmer.
Wow, you're right. The cold seems to have eased.
strings.이 일도 한지 오래돼서 그래요. 몇백 년 했나…?: I've been doing this for a long time. A few hundred years, maybe...?
strings.오래 전에 데이모스 교단이 저희 마을을 습격했을 때 도망치다가 여기까지: Long ago, when the Deimos cult attacked our village, I fled and ended up here. I'm one of the Kali people. You know Medea, right?
Medea rebuilt the village somewhere after that, but I couldn't find it. So Io passes along my regards when she visits now and then.
strings.그럼 가실까요? 절 따라 오세요. 절 따라오면 추운 기운을 별로 느끼실: Shall we go? Follow me. If you stay close, you won't feel the cold as much.
strings.티티, 그런 걸 어떻게 잘 알아요?: Titi, how do you know so much about that?
I'm not an ice spirit, but there's a spirit I call my big sister in the village.
strings.정령 누나요? 내가 아는 그런 정령인가?: A spirit? The kind of spirit I know?
strings.(여러 존재들이 있는 마을이네…. 하긴, 이스트랜드가 그런 대륙이니까.): (A village with all sorts of beings... Well, Eastland is that kind of continent.)
Sometimes, if you step in the wrong place, you'll fall right into the snow.
Aaaaaah! You should have told me that befo—
strings.이곳에 온 사람 중 제일 빨리 빠지셨네요. 기다리세요! 어떻게든 눈 속에: You fell in faster than anyone who's ever come here. Wait! I'll pull you out somehow!
strings.그러게, 제 말을 잘 들으셨어야죠. 안 그러면 얼어 죽었을 거라고요!: See? You should have listened to me. Otherwise, you might have frozen to death!
strings.그래도 몬스터들을 잘 물리치고, 티티가 눈 속에서 뽑아줘서 괜찮은 것 같: Still, we handled the monsters, and you pulled me out of the snow, so I think I'm fine.
strings.히히, 고마워요. 아, 마침 갈렛이 저기 있네요. 오늘도 반짝반짝 빛나는: Hehe, thank you. Oh, there's Galette. Shining as brightly as ever today! Hello!
strings.역시 제 얼굴을 알아주시는 건 형님 밖에 없군요. 그런데 옆에 계신 분은: You're the only one who appreciates my face, big brother. Is the person with you a traveler?
Yes. They came to meet Io.
strings.그분인가? 이오 님이 오늘 손님이 올 것 같다고 하면서 분주하게 움직이셨: Could this be the guest? Lady Io said she thought someone would arrive today, and she's been busy preparing.
strings.안녕하세요. 저는 반짝거리는 눈 위의 꽃, 여관 설화(雪花)를 운영하는: Hello. I'm Galette, the flower upon the glittering snow, and I run the Snowflower Inn.
Hello. It's nice to meet you. I'm %s...
strings.와아, 이름을 들으니 알 것 같아요. 푸른 창 길드를 박살내신 영웅! 마: Wow, now that I've heard your name, I know! The hero who smashed the Blue Spear Guild! Madeleine told me.
Ahaha... There were circumstances. But something smells delicious.
strings.마을 사람들과 손님들에게 대접할 여러 가지 음식을 만들고 있던 중이었어요: I was making a variety of dishes for the villagers and our guests.
I'll come back after meeting Lady Io.
strings.당연히 오셔야죠. %s 님께서 묵을 곳은 여기 밖에 없으니까요. 맛있는: Of course you must. There's nowhere else for you to stay, %s. Delicious food, comfortable beds, a place you'll never want to leave after your first visit.
Since you're here, eat before you go.
strings.어, 그럴까? %s 님, 이제 추운 게 많이 사라졌죠?: Oh, shall we? %s, you're feeling much less cold now, right?
Oh, it is warmer in the village. How strange.
It's the special energy of Gerda. Hehe. Go have a meal, like Galette said.
May I? I am hungry. Then thank you for the food.
strings.마침 특제 조미료와 산양 고기 육수를 넣고 졸인 '갈렛 특제 데보라 리소: I've just prepared Galette's Special Debora Risotto, simmered with my special seasoning and mountain goat broth. Enjoy!
strings.(갈렛이 준비한 맛있는 음식을 먹으면서 잠깐 여관에서 시간을 보낸다.): (The adventurer spends a little time at the inn, enjoying Galette's delicious food.)
I didn't know Debora's mountain goat meat was so delicious.
Uncle Valdrick alone has eaten an incredible number of those goats.
strings.옆에 있던 마법사가 거의 발드릭 아저씨 수준으로 먹던데…. 어, 저쪽으로: That mage beside us ate almost as much as Uncle Valdrick... Oh, he's heading that way. Does he have business with Io?
%s, let's go too. I'll guide you all the way to her.
strings.(저 멀리 보이는 저택이 눈과 얼음이 얇은 느낌으로 덮여있다. 손가락이라: (A mansion in the distance is covered in a delicate layer of snow and ice, thin enough to shatter at the lightest touch.)
strings.(그 앞에 아름다운 눈의 결정을 닮은 청초한 모습의 여성이 어떤 마법사: (Before it, a graceful woman as lovely as a snow crystal speaks with a young mage.)
Then I'll be going, Lady Io.
Thank you, Feta. You've been a great help.
strings.(이오에게 페타라 불린 마법사 소년이 이야기를 하고 돌아간다.): (The young mage Io called Feta finishes speaking and leaves.)
strings.%s, 저는 하던 일이 있어서 다시 설원으로 갈게요. 누나랑 말씀 나누세: %s, I have work to do, so I'll head back to the snowfields. Talk with Io. See you later too, Narin.
That's right. %s, the adventurer of Lady Iris, the new god of this world...
strings.데보라 설원만 해도 정령의 기운이 사뭇 달라지는 걸 느끼었는데, 그게 모: I felt the spirits' energy changing even in the Debora Snowfields. Was that your doing, Adventurer?
Yes. Lady Iris has changed now.
strings.이오 님도 느끼셨나요?: You felt it too, Lady Io?
strings.아무래도 나는 초인이고, 그런 걸 느낄 수밖에 없어…. 아, 맞다. 부탁: I'm a Champion, so I can't help feeling such things... Oh, right. I have a request.
I appreciate the courtesy, but just call me Io. I prefer it.
strings.그렇게 하시옵소서. 이오가 차가워 보인데다가 제멋대로 여서 그렇지 나름: Please do so. Io may look cold and be rather headstrong, but she is a kind child in her own way.
strings.아하하, 네. 그런데 이분은…. 정령? 어라…. 인간 마을에 정령이 있는: Ahaha, all right. But you are... a spirit? Oh... I've never seen a spirit in a human village before.
Hehe. Everyone is surprised at first. I am Narin, a spirit of water and ice.
strings.이오의 양친께서 설원에 쓰러져 있던 저를 구해주시고 거둬주셨지요. 그리고: Io's parents found me collapsed in the snowfields, rescued me, and took me in. I have lived here ever since.
They cherished me, giving me a name that means 'a child descended from the heavens.'
Thank you. Please feel free to use my name as well.
strings.인사는 이쯤 하고, 할 말이 있어. 여신께서 모험가를 이곳으로 보냈다면: Enough introductions. There's something to discuss. If the goddess sent you here, she must have meant for you to help me, right?
And the goddess must need my help, too.
strings.자, 이거 받아. 이건 데보라의 얼음이야. 보통 얼음은 아니지. 녹을 때: Here, take this. It's ice from Debora. No ordinary ice. Keep it until it melts, and my power will pass to the goddess on its own.
strings.고마워요, 이오. 그런데 제가 도와야 할 일이 뭐죠?: Thank you, Io. What do you need my help with?
The snow and ice of the Debora Snowfields are melting.
I didn't notice any melting on my way here.
strings.아마 %s의 눈에 보이지 않았을 거야. 보이는 것과 달리 보이지 않는 부: You probably couldn't see it, %s. Alongside what is visible, there are parts you can't see... You know what I mean by the reverse side, right?
strings.가이아 여신께서 이스트랜드를 구하신 후 데보라는 설원이 됐어. 특별한 정: After Goddess Gaia saved Eastland, Debora became a snowfield. The land holds a special purifying energy, and the beings here live upon that energy...
strings.그런 설원이 녹고 있어. 눈과 얼음이 녹으면 따뜻한 고대 시절의 데보라가: But the snowfields are melting. You might think melting snow and ice would return Debora to its warm, ancient state, but that isn't what will happen.
strings.여기가 지금껏 속박의 힘에 지배되지 않고 있었던 것은 데보라 설원의 눈과: This place has escaped the power of binding because Debora's snow and ice have protected it. Especially Echo Spring...
strings.그곳에 설원을 이루는 기운이 아주 강하게 있어. 거기에 내 친구 정령이: The energy that forms the snowfields is very strong there. A spirit friend of mine lives there. She asked for help because some power was melting the spring.
strings.그런데…. 지금 못 본지 좀 됐어. 어느 순간 변해버렸거든. 날 안에: But... I haven't seen her in a while. At some point, she changed. She won't let me in anymore...
Don't worry too much. There must be a reason.
As humans may be friends to spirits, so spirits may be friends to humans. Just as I am...
strings.에코는 데보라 설원에 있는 메아리의 샘에 있는 얼음 정령이옵니다. 저는: Echo is an ice spirit at Echo Spring in the Debora Snowfields. I have never met her myself. They say many water and ice spirits dwell there.
strings.정령이 있는 곳이라면 나린도 가서 만날 수 있지 않나요?: If spirits live there, couldn't you go and meet them too, Narin?
strings.하오나 저는 그곳이 어디에 있는지 알지 못하고, 찾은 적이 있사오나 들어: But I do not know where it is. I once found it, yet could not enter. And now I no longer know its location.
strings.나린 말대로야. 오직 나만 허락된 장소였는데…. 나린? 아, 나린도 느꼈: Just as Narin says. I was the only one allowed in... Narin? Ah, you felt it too.
strings.마을 저 밑에 있는 게 감옥…. 저 안에 뭔가 있나요?: That place beneath the village is a prison...? Is something inside?
Come with me, %s. I'll explain on the way.
Narin, stay here as always. Please.
Have no fear. Lady Narin the spirit's blessing shall protect the village.
strings.저 말투는 언제 들어도 적응이 되질 않는다니까. %s, 준비 됐어?: I'll never get used to the way she talks. %s, are you ready?
strings.(게르다 마을 한 편, 벽에 굳게 세워져 있는 창살 사이로 들어가자마자: (As they pass the sturdy bars built into a wall at the edge of Gerda, a powerful chill unlike anything in the snowfields surrounds them.)
strings.%s도 느꼈을 거야. 이곳은 속박에 걸린 광신도들을 가둬둔 감옥이야. 데: You must have felt it too, %s. This prison holds fanatics afflicted by binding. I'm purifying them with the Debora Snowfields' energy.
It's already been hundreds of years...
strings.처음엔 순수하게 뭔가를 믿고 있었지만, 잘못된 걸 몰랐겠지. 심장이 얼어: At first, they sincerely believed in something. They probably didn't know it was wrong. Their hearts froze, and they lost all sense of themselves...
strings.누군가에게 이용당해. 다른 생명을 죽이고, 생명의 힘을 모아 누군가에게: Someone uses them. They kill other living beings, gather their life force, and offer it to someone.
Some of those who now answer only to Weiss's messages must be someone's family or friends.
I... I wanted to save them. My father, my mother...
strings.죽은 이들은 어쩔 수 없고, 살아남아 괴물 같은 존재로 변한 이들에게 작: There's nothing I can do for the dead. But I hold on to a little hope for those who survived and became monsters.
strings.내 욕심일지도 모르지만…. 그들이 언젠가 햇빛을 봐야 하지 않겠어?: Maybe it's selfish of me... But shouldn't they see the sunlight again someday?
strings.그래서 새로운 여신이 힘을 얻는데 도움을 주고 있는 거야. 나 혼자의 힘: That's why I'm helping the new goddess gain power. I can't do it alone. Echo said she'd help, but I haven't received much...
strings.어쨌든 지금은 여기부터 봐야 해. 샘에 있던 힘을 품고 있던 설원이 녹으: Anyway, we need to deal with this first. As the snowfields holding the spring's power melt, the Icicle Prison seems to be melting too. Is the spring badly polluted?
strings.어떤 장소보다 단단한 얼음으로 세워진 곳인데…. 녹고 있다는 게 믿어지지: This place was built from ice harder than any other... I can't believe it's melting.
strings.이 포효는 분명…. 잠깐, 거기 누구야?: That roar is definitely... Wait, who's there?
Lady Io, Lady Io. Please save me...
Liriope? Why are you here? You should be with Echo at Echo Spring. And what are you saying?
strings.저를, 저를 구해주시옵소서. 죄송하옵니다. 저, 지금 그말 밖에 할 수: Please, please save me. I am sorry. I am sorry that is all I can say right now. Though I released him, it was not my will. Please forgive me.
strings.(리리오페가 물방울로 변하더니 퐁 하는 맑은 소리와 함께 사라진다.): (Liriope turns into a droplet and disappears with a clear plop.)
strings.(저 정령 나린과 말투가 비슷하네…. 대체 뭘 꾸미는 거지? 그리고 나와: (That spirit talks like Narin... What is she planning? And it felt as though she was waiting for Io and me.)
If she means him... I can't believe she woke him...
The yeti Argos. The sinner who made Gerda a living hell.
strings.이제 아무도 알아보지 못하는 괴물이니까 제대로 쓰러뜨려야 해. 그때보다: He's a monster who no longer recognizes anyone. We have to bring him down. I'm stronger than I was then, and now you're here too, %s.
strings.후우, 가자. 빨리 해결하고 나가자!: Whew. Let's go. Finish this quickly and get out!
strings.(감옥의 제일 깊은 장소, 거대한 존재가 나오지 못하도록 세워진 거대한: (In the deepest part of the prison, the enormous icicles built to contain a massive being lie shattered.)
I remember the hell you made of Gerda.
I hate telling this story, but I will.
Yetis lived in one part of the Debora Snowfields. My father and Uncle Argos were friends. Like Narin and me...
strings.설인들이 데이모스 교단에 사냥당하고, 함께 맞서 싸우던 이들은 돌아왔을: The Deimos cult hunted the yetis. Those who fought together against them returned under the power of binding.
strings.아르고스 아저씨는 함께 싸우던 마을 사람들을 알아보지 못하고 얼음 속에: Uncle Argos no longer recognized the villagers who had fought beside him and buried them in ice. And my father... my mother...
strings.살아남은 사람들이 아르고스 아저씨를 겨우 붙잡아 가둬놓았어. 그게 전부였: The survivors barely managed to capture and imprison Uncle Argos. That was all they could do. Back then, no one could kill a yeti with such monstrous strength...
I was young, but I grew stronger and built this prison to keep him from entering the world again.
strings.나는 아저씨를 저주해. 하지만, 이런 모습이 되는 걸 바라진 않았어. 이: I curse you, Uncle. But I never wanted you to become this. This is all what Weiss wanted!
I'm fine. I can. I have to. If I don't, then never... Huh?
strings.(이오의 앞으로 벽이 갈라지고 달려 있던 고드름이 떨어진다.): (The wall before Io splits, and icicles fall from it.)
strings.얼음이 녹는 속도가 빨라졌어…? 나린, 나린의 상태가 좋지 않은 건가?: The ice is melting faster...? Is something wrong with Narin?
strings.(이오가 자신을 감싸고 있던 한기를 모아 감옥에 결계를 펼친다.): (Io gathers the cold surrounding her and casts a barrier over the prison.)
strings.감옥이 무너지면 게르다가 위험해져…. 하지만, 아르고스 아저씨를 상대해야: If the prison collapses, Gerda will be in danger... But I have to face Uncle Argos...
strings.(아르고스가 거대한 얼음 둔기를 들어 이오를 공격한다. 하지만, %s의: (Argos lifts a huge ice club and attacks Io, only to recoil in surprise at %s's counterattack.)
That yeti doesn't seem to recognize me.
strings.(아르고스 아저씨의 공격을 정확히 받아치다니….): (Such a precise counter to Uncle Argos's attack...)
strings.제가 싸울게요. 그러니까 이오는 고드름 감옥이 무너지지 않게 해주세요!!: I'll fight him. Io, keep the Icicle Prison from collapsing!
strings.알았어!! 그러니까 조심해!! 지금 아르고스 아저씨가 잔뜩 화가 났으니까: All right! Be careful! Uncle Argos is furious now.
strings.(아르고스가 큰 목소리로 소리를 지르자 이오의 결계가 흔들린다. 심지어: (Argos's roar shakes Io's barrier. The cracks in the Icicle Prison's walls widen.)
strings.(%s의 일격이 닿자마자, 힘이 풀린 아르고스가 그대로 주저앉는다.): (As %s's strike connects, Argos loses his strength and collapses.)
I have to bring him down properly. Otherwise...
strings.크르르르…. 으…. 으…. 나는 왜….너는 누구지? 위버? 여기는 어디…: Grrrr... Ugh... Ugh... Why am I... Who are you? Weaver? Where is this...?
The one who was with the goddess... Or not? Why am I here? I was... Why am I attacking you?
strings.(이오가 믿을 수 없는 표정을 지으며 아르고스에게 가까이 가던 중, 놀라: (With disbelief on her face, Io approaches Argos, then stumbles in surprise.)
It really is you, Io. Still so clumsy, falling over... Here, get up.
strings.아저씨는 아저씨구나. 아저씨는 변하지 않았는데…. 변하지 않았는데, 속박: You're still you, Uncle. You haven't changed... You haven't changed, but the binding...
strings.(이오가 아르고스의 손을 붙잡고 일어난다. 이오의 안에서 오랜 시간 참고: (Io takes Argos's hand and rises. Emotions she has held back for centuries surge within her.)
I'm sorry. I can't remember any of it... I'm sorry...
Tell me what happened while I was under the binding. I'll accept all of it...
strings.(아르고스가 체념한 듯한 눈빛으로 이오를 바라본다.): (Argos looks at Io with resigned eyes.)
The hell you made of Gerda...
strings.(이오가 눈물을 닦고 아르고스를 올려다본다. 그리고 그의 앞에 앉아 지난: (Io wipes her tears and looks up at Argos. Sitting before him, she recounts the years that have passed.)
strings.(너무 끔찍한 이야기야…. 왜 초인들에겐 이런 시련들이….): (What a terrible story... Why do the Champions have to endure such trials...?)
I fell under the binding, failed to recognize my friends, and committed terrible sins. I'm sorry.
strings.그런데 아저씨와 아빠는 언제 바이스를 만난 거야? 아저씨를 이렇게 묶어둔: But when did you and Father meet Weiss? He's the only one who could bind you like this...
strings.우리는 설원에 나타난 데이모스 교단의 광신도를 쫓던 중, 어떤 샘과 그: We were pursuing Deimos fanatics who had appeared in the snowfields when we found a spring. Beside it lay a spirit who had lost her memories.
strings.어린 정령은 자신이 왜 여기에 있는지 기억하지 못했고, 두려워했지. 그래: The young spirit could not remember why she was there, and she was afraid. So Inachus took her back to the village.
strings.이후, 우리는 샘에서 속박의 힘 일부가 만들어져 퍼지는 걸 발견했다. 그: Later, we discovered that part of the binding's power was being created and spread from the spring. While investigating, a terrified spirit begged us for help.
strings.날개가 얼어있던 정령의 요청에 우리는 알고 싶었다. 어째서 샘에서 정화의: Her wings were frozen. Hearing her plea, we wanted to learn why we could feel both purifying energy and the power of binding in the spring.
Inachus, who could communicate with the spirit, promised to restore her wings.
strings.그런데 어느 날, 정령이 샘 안쪽으로 인도했다. 그것은 오산이었지. 정령: But one day, she led us deeper into the spring. Following her was a mistake. Her eyes no longer held the look we knew. Her entire presence had changed.
Her attack froze us, and that was when we met Weiss. Then...
strings.내가 어떻게든 하려고 했지만, 일반적인 정령의 공격이 아니었다. 그 정령: I tried to do something, but it was no ordinary spirit's attack. She already possessed an alien power.
strings.…아르고스 아저씨, 그 정령 어떻게 생겼어?: ...Uncle Argos, what did that spirit look like?
strings.키가 크고 얼어버린 날개 한쪽이 반밖에 없었다. 분명 메아리의 샘을 지키: She was tall, and one of her frozen wings was half missing. It was definitely Echo, guardian of Echo Spring...
strings.(분명 이오의 친구라고 했던….): (The one Io said was her friend...)
That is where my memories end... I'm sorry, Io... I will pay for my sins. Kill me.
strings.…그래요. 그게 아저씨가 원하는 거라면…. 그리고 게르다의 대표인 내가: ...All right. If that is what you want... And as Gerda's representative, it is something I can do...
I had already prepared myself for this...
strings.(이오의 말이 끝나기 전에 어디선가 거대하고 불길한 힘이 날아온다. 하지: (Before Io can finish, an enormous, ominous force flies toward them. She senses it and creates a great ice shield, deflecting the attack.)
Someone must want to freeze to death. Bringing the power of binding all the way here? How dare you...
Echo, come out. Come out and talk.
strings.(이오의 말과 함께 땅에서 얼음이 물방울처럼 튀어올라 어떤 여성의 형상을: (At Io's words, ice springs from the ground like droplets and takes the form of a woman.)
strings.(얼어 있는 정령의 날개는 아름답게 느껴지지만, 부서져 있던 왼쪽 날개를: (The spirit's frozen wings are beautiful, but an ominous power emanates from the broken left wing.)
strings.(아르고스가 에코에게 다가가려고 한 순간, 아르고스의 온 몸에서 거대하고: (The instant Argos tries to approach Echo, dozens of enormous, sharp icicles erupt from his body.)
strings.(아르고스의 얼굴이 힘없이 그대로 바닥으로 떨어진다.): (Argos's head drops lifelessly to the floor.)
strings.(에코가 가볍게 미소지으며 이오를 바라본다.): (Echo looks at Io with a faint smile.)
strings.너는 분명 나에게 메아리의 샘을 나올 수 없다고 했지? 그런데 여기 와서: You told me you couldn't leave Echo Spring. So what are you doing here?
strings.게다가 내가 싫어하는 속박의 힘을 퍼뜨리고 있어. 그리고 구해달라고? 대: And you're spreading the binding I hate. Now you're asking me to save you? What on earth...? You won't even let me in.
strings.나를 구해줘. 그러니 메아리의 샘으로 와……. 샘으로 가는 길은 널 위해: Save me. Come to Echo Spring... The path to the spring is open for you...
strings.(에코가 말과는 달리 금방이라도 이오를 향해 공격할 것처럼 거대한 얼음들: (Despite her words, Echo creates enormous shards of ice as though ready to attack Io.)
strings.(에코라는 정령의 상태가 이상해. 이대로라면 이오도 위험해…. 어?): (Something is wrong with Echo. Io will be in danger at this rate... Huh?)
strings.(에코가 만들어낸 날카로운 고드름이 그대로 녹아 바닥으로 떨어진다. 그리: (The sharp icicles Echo created melt and fall to the floor. Echo herself turns into droplets and disappears.)
strings.하아…. 하아…. 아, 숨막혀. 숨을 쉴 수가 없어. 으, 으윽…. 윽…: Hah... hah... I can't breathe. I'm suffocating. U-ugh... ugh...
strings.서, 서둘러 나가야 해. 여기 속박의 기운이 가득해…. 에코가 퍼뜨리고: W-we have to get out quickly. The binding's energy fills this place... Echo left it behind...
strings.이오, 정신차려요! 제가 붙잡고 나갈테니까!!: Io, stay with me! I'll carry you out!
%s! I've been waiting! Quickly, come here!
strings.(나린이 일행을 보자마자 만들어낸 거대한 물방울을 고드름 감옥 입구쪽으로: (The moment Narin sees them, she sends an enormous droplet toward the Icicle Prison's entrance.)
That should keep the evil power from escaping the Icicle Prison.
Io, I would like to know what happened...
I'm fine. I just want a moment to sort things out in my head.
strings.네, 그럼 나린에게 이야기할게요. 나린, 고드름 감옥에서 무슨 일이 있었: All right. I'll tell her. Narin, what happened in the Icicle Prison was...
strings.(나린에게 고드름 감옥에서 있었던 일을 이야기한다.): (The adventurer tells Narin what happened in the Icicle Prison.)
strings.에코와 리리오페라는 정령이 자기를 구해달라면서 그런 짓을 저질렀단 말이옵: These spirits, Echo and Liriope, did such things while asking you to save them?
And even attacked with the power of binding...
strings.지금 여기선 아무것도 알 수 없사옵니다. 그러니 그곳에 가서 알아봐야 할: We can learn nothing here. We must go there and investigate...
strings.아니지. 정령의 일이라면 인간인 너보다 내가 도움이 될 게야. 여기는 안: No. If this concerns spirits, I can help more than a human. This place is safe. Io, do you doubt my power?
strings.그런 건 아니야. 메아리의 샘에 가까이 갈 수 없는 사실을 이야기할 뿐이: That isn't it. I'm only saying you can't approach Echo Spring.
...Perhaps I might discover what I have wanted to know.
strings.마지막으로 들어가려고 했던 게 언제였어?: When did you last try to enter?
strings.아마 50년 전인가…. 샘이 있는 구역 안에 들어가려다 펼쳐진 결계 때문: About fifty years ago, perhaps... I tried to enter the area around the spring, but a barrier stopped me. You were the one who took me there.
strings.(분명 나린과 그 리리오페라는 정령이 비슷해 보였어….): (Narin and that spirit Liriope really did look alike...)
strings.이오, 나도 갈 것이다. 동행해도 되겠지? %s 님, 저도 동행해도 되겠: Io, I am going too. May I accompany you? %s, would you permit me to join you?
Let's go to Echo Spring. I'll lead the way. Let's meet Echo.
...If Uncle Argos was telling the truth, then Echo is hiding something. I need to know what.
I have a duty to know, for the snowfields and the village.
strings.(이오의 말과 함께 손끝에서 차가운 냉기가 흘러나온다. 동요하지 않도록: (Cold flows from Io's fingertips as she speaks. She struggles to steady her energy and keep her composure.)
strings.온 몸에서 속박의 힘으로 태어난 고드름이 솟았어. 그 고드름 때문에 설인: Icicles born from the power of binding burst from his entire body. Those icicles killed yetis and people.
strings.그런 공격이라면 아무리 나라도 감당할 수 없어. 그나마 샤이닉 언니라면: Even I couldn't withstand an attack like that. Shynic might be all right, but...
strings.(나린이 순간적으로 패닉에 빠진 것 같다.): (Narin seems to have fallen into a sudden panic.)
strings.시간이 꽤 오래 지난 것 같은데 샤이닉 언니 이름만으로 저러네. 정신 차: It's been so long, yet just hearing Shynic's name does this to her. Snap out of it, Narin!
strings.(이오가 나린을 붙잡고 마구 흔든다.): (Io grabs Narin and shakes her vigorously.)
strings.상황이 상황이니만큼, 빨리 가자. 아르고스 아저씨의 명복은 빌지 않아도: Given the situation, we need to hurry. There's no need to stop and pray for Uncle Argos.
Thank you. I knew you would. Then let's go to Madeleine.
Madeleine is one of our village's warriors. A truly excellent archer.
Yes. Let's go to Madeleine... and meet Echo...
strings.괜찮지 않은 일이라 하더라도 나는 괜찮아야 해. 에코가 숨기고 있는게 뭔: Even if things aren't all right, I have to be. I don't know what Echo is hiding, but if it threatens Gerda...
strings.여신의 이름으로 소멸시켜야겠지…. 후우, 여신께서 원하시는지 원치 않으시: I'll have to destroy it in the goddess's name... Whew. Though I don't know whether the goddess would wish that or not...
Lady Io? Lady Narin? What brings you...
strings.살짝 별 일이 있어요. 아직도 전 이곳에 샘이 있는지 잘 모르겠지만, 그: A little. I still don't really know whether there's a spring here, but I've kept watch as you instructed.
The water's flow and energy have definitely changed...
strings.역시 마들린은 뛰어난 인재야. 여기 갈렛이 마들린 주라고 도시락 줬으니까: You're as capable as ever, Madeleine. Here, Galette packed you a lunch. Eat it when you have time.
Galette has packed plenty of all your favorites.
It's nice to meet you. I'm %s...
Perhaps you've heard of this person, Madeleine.
strings.란다인을 쓰러뜨린 분이시군요…. 고맙습니다. 그렇게 하지 않으셨다면 그: The one who defeated Randaine... Thank you. If you hadn't, he would have become even more of a monster.
Don't worry about it. You only did what you had to, %s.
strings.이오 님, 샘이란 곳에 가실 예정이신가요?: Lady Io, are you going to the spring?
Yes. But it will be different from before. Madeleine, I have a favor to ask.
strings.(이오가 마들린에게 작은 얼음 조각을 건넨다.): (Io gives Madeleine a small piece of ice.)
strings.이 얼음이 만약 녹는다면, 당장 마을로 가서 내 저택에 불을 붙여. 그리: If this ice melts, go straight to the village and set my mansion on fire. Then take everyone to Mars immediately.
strings.너무 걱정하지 마. 내가 있고, 여기 나린이 있어. 게다가 여신의 사람인: Don't worry too much. I'm here, and so is Narin. And we have %s, the goddess's chosen adventurer.
strings.적어도 내가 사랑하는 사람들을 다치게 하진 않아. 마들린도 알지? 내가: At the very least, I won't let the people I love get hurt. You know what kind of person I am, Madeleine.
strings.(이오가 씨익 웃으며 마들린의 어깨를 두드린다.): (Io grins and pats Madeleine on the shoulder.)
strings.(확실히 마음이 강한 사람이란 게 느껴져.….): (I can feel how strong her spirit is...)
strings.이오, 결계가 날 가로막고 있는 것 같다. 전에는 그냥 막아놓은 것 같은: Io, the barrier seems to be blocking me. Before, it merely barred the way. Now it is rejecting me. Only me...
strings.(이오가 손을 뻗어 휘젓는다. 그리고 뭔가 느꼈는지 불쾌한 듯한 표정을: (Io reaches out and waves a hand. Sensing something, she looks displeased.)
strings.바뀌었어…. 나린만은 갈 수 없게…. 저기, %s. 여기에 손을 뻗어봐: It's changed... To keep only Narin out... %s, reach out here.
All right, but what is here? Oh, this...
You can feel it even if you don't want to, can't you? This is...
strings.나린, 그러면 마들린과 함께 여기 있어줘. 네가 여기 있어야 설원과 게르: Narin, stay here with Madeleine, then. With you here, the snowfields and Gerda will remain stable... And if anything happens, go with Madeleine...
Yes, I understand. Enough words. Go and return safely.
Thank you, Narin. %s, let's go. Follow me.
strings.(얼음 사이로 보이는 작은 물길이 어딘가로 흘러간다. 시야 사이로 보이는: (A narrow stream winds between the ice. The water in sight appears contaminated, stained an unfamiliar color.)
Keep your wits about you. This energy...
Yes, I'll be careful. Io, there are droplets ahead...
strings.(메아리의 샘에 들어서자마자 고드름 감옥에서 봤었던 똑같은 물방울이 아래: (As soon as they enter Echo Spring, the same droplets seen in the Icicle Prison rise from below.)
strings.그래, 리리오페라는 정령이지. 에코의 곁에서 시중을 드는…. 그렇다고 해: Yes. The spirit called Liriope. She attends Echo... But don't take her lightly.
strings.리리오페는 상급 정령이거든. 여신님의 심상세계에 머무는 하르모니아와 기아: Liriope is a high-ranking spirit. Though she isn't at the level of Harmonia or Geis in the goddess's Inner World...
strings.(물방울이 천천히 모여 리리오페의 모습으로 변한다.): (The droplets slowly gather into Liriope's form.)
strings.대체 뭘 용서하라는 거지? 여전히 네 의지가 아니라고 말하고 싶은 거지?: What exactly am I supposed to forgive? You still want to say this isn't your will?
strings.(저 정령, 입과는 다른 행동을 하고 있어. 금방이라도 우리를 죽일 기세: (Her actions don't match her words. She looks ready to kill us... Io must know.)
It is not my will. All of this...
strings.그렇겠지. 리리오페 같은 상급 정령을 함부로 할 수 있는 건 역시 강한: Of course. It would take great power to control a high-ranking spirit like you. But a god wouldn't mistreat spirits like this.
strings.에코, 나와. 대체 뭘 꾸미고 있는 거야?: Echo, come out. What are you planning?
strings.(땅에서 얼음이 물방울처럼 튀어 올라 벗어나려는 리리오페를 감싸더니 얼려: (Ice leaps from the ground like droplets, surrounds Liriope as she tries to escape, and freezes her. One droplet slowly takes Echo's form.)
Io, you came to save me.
strings.(잠시 후, 얼어버린 리리오페의 몸이 조금씩 금이 가 산산조각난다.): (A moment later, Liriope's frozen body begins to crack, then shatters.)
Just as I hoped, Io. You came to save me. This isn't my will. But it's all right. There are other Liriopes to serve me, so it's fine.
strings.(에코가 환한 웃음을 지으며 힘차게 날개짓을 한다. 하지만, 작은 날개가: (Echo smiles brightly and beats her wings. But the smaller wing cannot move properly, and she winces in pain.)
strings.으아아아악…. 이건 전부…. 날 구해줘. 나를 구해줘…. 샘 끝으로 와…: Aaaaaagh... All of this... Save me. Save me... Come to the far end of the spring...
strings.(고통을 호소하던 에코의 모습이 얼어버린다. 잠시 후, 에코는 물방울처럼: (Echo freezes as she cries out in pain. A moment later, she scatters like droplets and flows away into Echo Spring.)
strings.이오, 잘 생각해야 해요. 리리오페는 두려워하고 있었지만, 에코는 아니에: Io, think carefully. Liriope was afraid, but Echo wasn't. She was enjoying herself.
strings.나도 알고 있어. 아르고스 아저씨처럼 속박에 당한 것처럼 연기하고 있었어: I know. She was pretending to be bound like Uncle Argos...
strings.이쯤 됐으니 더는 속아줄 수도 없어. 에코의 이야기를 더 들어봐야겠지만…: I can't let myself be fooled any longer. I still need to hear what Echo has to say, but...
Let's go, %s. Echo Spring has many paths that loop back on themselves, so follow carefully. I'm the only one besides the spirits who knows the way.
All right. Let's hurry. We don't know what that spirit will do...
If we follow the clear water...
strings.(맑은 물의 흐름이 멈춘 장소, 보라색으로 물든 얼음과 물이 뒤섞여 불쾌: (Where the clear water stops, purple-stained ice and water mingle, intensifying the sense of revulsion.)
strings.에코도 더는 부정할 수 없겠지. 이 힘에 당했던 사람이 둘이나 여기 있으: Echo won't be able to deny it now. Two people who have suffered from this power are standing here.
strings.그러면 에코를 나오게 해볼까?: Shall we make her come out?
strings.(말이 끝나자마자 이오의 손 끝에 거대한 얼음 결정이 피어오른다.): (A huge ice crystal blooms at Io's fingertips.)
Echo, you won't be able to endure this.
strings.(이오가 손을 흔들자 거대한 얼음 결정이 조각나 샘 이곳저곳으로 떨어진다: (Io waves her hand. The huge crystal shatters and scatters across the spring. As its fragments melt, sacred power spreads.)
...It feels like when I met the goddess.
There's a mixture of things in it. Especially when purifying...
strings.(얼음 결정이 모여 에코의 형상을 만들어낸다. 모두에게 나타난 에코는 고: (Ice crystals gather into Echo's form. She struggles to stand, wrapping her arms around herself in pain.)
I'm happy you came to save me, Io. But you mustn't purify this place...
strings.그러면 내가 밖을 나갈 수 없거든. 이 힘이 내가 밖을 나갈 수 있게 하: Then I won't be able to leave. This power is what lets me go outside.
strings.(에코가 씨익 웃자 정화의 기운이 흔적도 없이 사라져버린다. 그리고 불길: (Echo grins, and the purifying energy vanishes without a trace. The ominous power grows stronger and forms an enormous icicle.)
strings.고마워, 그 아이까지 이곳에 오게 해줘서…. 그동안 모아왔던 힘으로 그: Thank you for bringing that child here too... I'll use all the power I've gathered to destroy her.
The one who imprisoned me here so I could never leave...
strings.(거대한 고드름이 천천히 하늘로 올라가 떠오른다.): (The enormous icicle slowly rises into the sky.)
Io, what is she talking about? What does that spirit mean...?
strings.그래서 나린을 죽이려고?: So you're going to kill Narin?
strings.…그 아이가 죽으면 데보라의 모든 눈과 얼음이 녹을 거야. 이오, 너도: ...When that child dies, all the snow and ice in Debora will melt. Isn't that what you want too, Io? For Debora's living beings to be free of the snow and ice?
The power of binding has driven you mad.
I'm not mad. You're the one who mistakenly thought we were friends...
strings.시간이 되면 저 고드름은 정확히 떨어질 거야. 이오, 고마워. 날 믿고: When the time comes, that icicle will fall exactly where it should. Thank you, Io. For trusting me and coming all the way to your grave.
...Using trust as bait. You don't deserve to be called a spirit.
I don't care. I have to get out. I have to take revenge on those who imprisoned me.
Io, hurry to the spring's entrance.
strings.걱정하지 마요. 저 어리석은 정령은 내가 어떻게든 쓰러뜨릴게요. 이 정령: Don't worry. I'll bring that foolish spirit down somehow. Defeating her may be...
strings.이리스를 위한 일일 수도 있으니까요. 그러니 이오는 서둘러 밖으로 나가요: Something I need to do for Iris as well. So hurry outside, Io!
strings.알았어. 부탁할게!!: All right. I'm counting on you!
strings.(이오가 뛰어갈 동안 에코는 가만히 그 모습을 지켜본다. 그리고 조용히: (Echo quietly watches Io run. Then she turns toward %s's gaze.)
strings.…이제 이 세계는 없을 거야. 그의 뜻대로 되기 전에 난 이곳을 벗어날: ...Soon this world will be gone. I'll escape before his will is fulfilled.
strings.부정하지 않는 걸 보니 맞나보네. 그러면 제대로 상대해줄게. 적어도 네: You aren't denying it, so I must be right. Then I'll give you a proper fight. At least I need to show you that you chose wrong.
strings.(에코가 감고 있던 눈을 뜨자 샘 주위에 맴돌고 있던 속박의 기운이 강해: (As Echo opens her eyes, the power of binding around the spring intensifies.)
strings.(오래 끌면 위험해. 빨리 끝내야겠어.): (Drawing this out will be dangerous. I have to finish quickly.)
strings.(정령의 고통스러워하는 비명이 샘 전체에 울려 퍼진다. 샘 이름처럼 반복: (The spirit's agonized scream echoes through the entire spring. True to the spring's name, the repeated sound seems to draw even the listener into her pain.)
strings.(에코가 주저앉은 채 고통스러운 표정으로 몸을 감싸고 있다.): (Echo sits on the ground, clutching herself in pain.)
strings.이제 네가 할 수 있는 건 없어. 속박의 힘을 이용한 것부터 네가 잘못됐: There's nothing more you can do. You know you were wrong the moment you chose to use binding, don't you?
strings.나는 그저 밖으로 나가고 싶었을 뿐이야. 이 세계를 떠나지 말라고 신들에: I only wanted to go outside. All I did was tell the gods not to abandon this world. Why was I punished...?
strings.(고대의 정령인가? 확실히 보통 정령은 아니지….): (An ancient spirit? She certainly isn't ordinary...)
strings.그래서 속박의 힘으로 밖으로 나가려고 했던 거야?: So you tried to use binding to escape?
strings.정령의 힘이 아닌 속박의 힘으로? 그동안 속박의 힘이 이스트랜드에 무슨: Using binding instead of a spirit's power? Don't you know what binding has done to Eastland?
strings.나가기만 한다면 속박의 힘이라도 상관없어. 바이스가 준 힘이 게르다까지는: I don't care if it's binding, as long as I can leave. The power Weiss gave me let me reach Gerda.
strings.정령의 힘과 속박이 함께 한다면 나를 이곳에 가둔 존재한테 복수도 가능해: With spirit power and binding together, I could take revenge on the one who imprisoned me... That's why I woke the bound Argos and waited for Io and that child to come!
strings.(에코가 소리 지르자 등 뒤에 있던 얼음 날개가 떨어진다.): (As Echo screams, the ice wings on her back fall away.)
strings.아르고스가 했던 말이 거짓이 아니었네…. 이오를 속이고 오랫동안 친구인: So Argos wasn't lying... You deceived Io and pretended to be her friend all those years...
strings.속박의 힘만 이용할 수 있으면 여기서 나갈 수 있다고 그가 말해서 난 그: He said I could escape if I used the power of binding. I only did what he told me...
I didn't know it would take away the people Io treasured...
Io, who cared for me so much...
strings.(에코가 괴로워하면서 몸을 떨기 시작한다. 이어 샘을 감싸고 있던 속박의: (Echo trembles in anguish. The poisonous binding energy around the spring repeatedly gathers and scatters.)
strings.바이스, 날 죽여!! 차라리 날 죽여라!!: Weiss, kill me! Just kill me!
strings.(에코의 외침과 함께 물길에서 거대한 물보라가 피어오른다. 그리고 그 모: (At Echo's cry, a great surge of water erupts from the stream and sends %s flying.)
strings.(쿵, 하는 소리와 함께 샘의 허공에 떠 있던 거대한 고드름이 그대로 떨: (With a crash, the enormous icicle hanging over the spring falls straight down.)
strings.(에코가 있던 자리엔 깨진 얼음 조각들이 어지럽혀져 있을 뿐, 에코였던: (Only broken shards of ice remain where Echo stood. The being who was Echo has vanished without a trace.)
strings.(물안개가 피어오르는 얼음 조각 사이로 불길한 힘의 소유자가 천천히 걸어: (Amid mist rising from the broken ice, the bearer of the ominous power slowly walks out.)
strings.어리석은 정령…, 속박의 힘에 시달리면서도 이오를 위해서 이런 선택을 하: Foolish spirit... Even tormented by binding, she chose this for Io's sake...
strings.그저 오래전 속박의 힘을 나눠준 것 뿐이다. 정령이 그걸 사용하다 샘을: I merely shared the power of binding long ago. The spirit used it, polluted the spring, and cast it upon the yetis and humans.
strings.다른 인격이 된 자들은 그저 서로 싸우고 죽이면서 생명의 힘을 나한테 가: Those whose minds changed fought and killed one another, offering their life force to me. Does that answer your question?
strings.…너는 대체 원하는 게 뭐지? 아즈라엘이 대체 뭔데 이러는 거야?: ...What do you want? What is Azrael that makes you do all this?
strings.다른 세계의 생명이 사랑하는 세계…. 나도 조금씩 잊어가는군. 그 계약: A world loved by lives from another world... I, too, am slowly forgetting. Because of that contract...
strings.무기를 쥔 손에 힘을 빼라. 여기서 네가 죽어버린다면 여신이 슬퍼할텐데: Loosen your grip on your weapon. If you die here, the goddess will grieve. Are you all right with that?
We'll meet soon in Avalon... I'll be waiting.
strings.(바이스가 미소를 짓자 어디선가 나타난 보라색 불꽃이 타오른다. 불꽃은: (Weiss smiles, and purple flames appear from nowhere. They envelop him, then vanish without a trace.)
strings.그러고보니 샘 안에서 느꼈던 불길한 기운이 모두 사라졌어. 에코가 사라져: Now that I think about it, all the ominous energy in the spring is gone. Because Echo disappeared? Or because Weiss did...?
If Deimos is going to appear in Avalon...
First, let's get out and meet Io. I can decide after that.
Oh, what's that? Ah... Echo's wing...
I should take it out and show Io.
The icicle in the sky is gone.
strings.불길한 기운도 많이 사라졌어요. 그건 그렇고 이오 님, 나린 님? 저 이: Much of the ominous energy is gone too. But Lady Io, Lady Narin... I'd like to get out from between you now...
strings.(손을 맞잡고 결계를 치고 있던 이오와 나린 사이에 껴있던 마들린이 손을: (Madeleine, caught between Io and Narin as they hold hands to maintain a barrier, raises a hand.)
Weiss came and went while we were here.
For him to come all this way and do nothing...
strings.그 못된 인간이 평소대로 뭔가 꾸미고 터뜨린 거야. 언제나 그렇듯이. 어: That wretched man plotted something and set it off, as always. I have some idea, but let's hear it from %s when the adventurer returns.
Io, the land is freezing again.
strings.얼어붙고 있는 걸 정상이라고 해야 하나…. 우리 입장에선 정상이 맞지만…: Should we call freezing normal...? It is normal for us, but...
strings.(나린이 하늘을 바라보다 갑자기 주저앉는다.): (Narin looks up at the sky, then suddenly collapses.)
I don't know why I'm like this. I feel weak, unlike usual...
I think I'm all right for now... Ugh...
strings.이오, 나린! 저 왔어요. 어? 나린, 무슨 일 있어요? 고드름은 분명: Io, Narin! I'm back. Huh? Narin, is something wrong? The icicle should be gone...
strings.(이오에게 에코와 있었던 일을 이야기하고, 에코의 날개였던 물건을 보여준: (The adventurer tells Io what happened with Echo and shows her the object that was Echo's wing.)
Echo's ice wing. It's full of binding energy...
strings.이오, 이 물건 내가 써도 되겠느냐?: Io, may I use this object?
strings.속박의 기운이 남아있는데 괜찮아?: Will you be all right? Binding energy still remains in it.
Nothing will happen. Please let me use it.
All right. Do as you wish.
strings.1시간 정도 지나면 우리들을 깨우면 된단다. 잠들지 않으면 데보라의 눈을: Wake us in about an hour. If someone doesn't fall asleep, use Debora's snow.
strings.(나린이 품에 있던 두루마리를 펼치고, 그 위에 에코의 얼음 날개를 올려: (Narin unfolds a scroll and places Echo's ice wing on it. A moment later, the wing melts into tiny droplets that rise into the sky.)
strings.(이오와 나린이 아무렇지도 않은 듯이 나란히 얼음 바위에 기대 눈을 감는: (Io and Narin calmly lean against an icy rock side by side and close their eyes.)
strings.(갑자기 잠이 오는데…. 이러면 안 되는데….): (I'm suddenly sleepy... I shouldn't fall asleep here...)
strings.걱정하지 마시고 눈을 감으세요. 아프진 않을 거에요. 나린 님하고 이오: Don't worry. Close your eyes. It won't hurt. Lady Narin and Lady Io said it would be all right...
strings.(마들린이 정신을 붙잡으려 노력하는 %s의 앞에 눈을 한아름 모아 보여준: (Madeleine gathers a great armful of snow before %s, who struggles to stay awake. A moment later, an enormous snowball flies into %s's view with a solid thump.)
strings.(이오가 쓰러진 %s의 얼굴을 빤히 바라보다가 얼굴에 있던 눈가루를 치워: (Io looks down at %s's fallen face and brushes away the snow.)
Ugh, what happened? It feels like something hit me...
My face is a bit too sore for that.
strings.됐고, 이런 일 많이 겪어봤지? 이번에도 비슷할 거야. 누군가의 기억을: Never mind. You've been through things like this before, right? This will be similar. We're looking through someone's memories.
strings.미안해, 이오. 몰랐어. 에코의 날개가 가지고 있던 기억이 그때의 시간인: I'm sorry, Io. I didn't know. I didn't know Echo's wing held memories of that time...
strings.괜찮아. 어쩔 수 없는 거니까. 아, %s. 이제 조용히 보고 있으면 돼: It's all right. It can't be helped. Oh, %s. Just watch quietly now. Only watch. You'll understand everything...
When it's over, I'll curse Weiss all over again...
strings.(이오와 나린이 눈을 마주치고 다시 앞을 바라보자 그들의 모습이 흔적도: (Io and Narin meet each other's eyes, then look ahead. Their figures vanish without a trace.)
strings.(그저 하얀 눈과 얼음이 가득한 데보라의 풍경만이 가득할 뿐이다. 그러던: (Only Debora's landscape of white snow and ice remains. Then a familiar voice sounds across the snowfields.)
I only wanted to go outside. This isn't what I wanted.
What I ruined was not you. It was other lives...
You knew from the moment you accepted another world's power.
strings.(에코가 두려워하자 주위에 거대한 얼음 결정이 떠오른다. 바이스를 찌르려: (As Echo trembles in fear, enormous ice crystals appear around her. They fly toward Weiss as if to pierce him, but melt away before reaching him.)
strings.호기심 많은 정령은 시공간의 틈을 바라보다 다른 세계의 기운에 동화됐었지: A curious spirit gazed into a rift in spacetime and became attuned to another world's energy.
strings.그걸 우려하던 다른 정령을 미워한 나머지 고드름으로 눈을 찔러 보지 못하: Resenting another spirit who worried about this, she pierced that spirit's eyes with icicles and blinded her.
strings.물과 얼음의 정령왕이 이 사실을 알고 분노해 그 정령을 추방했지만, 그래: The Spirit King of Water and Ice learned of it and, in anger, banished the offender. Yet still caring for her, the Spirit King allowed her to remain in a certain place.
strings.그런 정령왕이 이곳에 온 적이 있었다. 정령은 정령왕이 왔을 때, 잘못을: That Spirit King once came here. The spirit pretended to repent, approached, and cast binding upon the visitor...
strings.정령왕은 샘밖으로 겨우 빠져나왔지만, 이내 사라지고 말았다. 정령은 사라: The Spirit King barely escaped the spring, then disappeared. To find the vanished Spirit King and take revenge, the spirit used the humans and yeti who came to her.
No. These are facts without a single lie.
strings.가면을 쓰고 있는 인간은 많이 봤지만, 정령은 처음이군. 복수의 여신 네: I've seen many humans wear masks, but never a spirit. Were you trying to become Nemesis, goddess of vengeance?
strings.속박의 힘은 이 세계의 생명이 가진 가장 추악한 것…, 지금 그것이 나와: Binding is the ugliest thing possessed by the lives of this world... And if that is now connected to me...
strings.(바닥에서 솟아난 거대한 얼음 조각이 바이스의 심장을 빠른 속도로 파고들: (An enormous shard of ice erupts from the floor and shoots toward Weiss's heart, only to shatter before reaching him.)
...I do not vanish just because some spirit tells me to.
strings.무, 무슨 짓을 하려는 거지?: Wh-what are you going to do?
These useless wings that can no longer fly...
strings.(바이스가 에코에게 다가가 날개를 붙잡고 꺾어버린다. 에코의 한쪽 날개가: (Weiss approaches Echo, seizes a wing, and bends it back. One frozen wing breaks apart.)
strings.(듣기 싫을 정도로 고통스럽게만 느껴지는 정령의 비명소리가 샘에 계속해서: (The spirit's agonized screams continue to echo through the spring, painful even to hear.)
strings.네가 원한 속박에 의해 구속된 기분이 어떤가? 그러니 내가 원하는 때마다: How does it feel to be restrained by the binding you wanted? Now gather life force under that binding whenever I wish!
strings.널 도와주려고 했던 게르다의 인간과 설인을 이용해 서로 죽이게 했던 그때: Just as you used Gerda's humans and yeti, who wanted to help you, and made them kill each other!
strings.그리고 때가 되면 다시 눈을 뜨고, 때가 되면 다시 눈을 감아라. 나약한: And open your eyes when the time comes. Close them again when the time comes. Like the powerless goddess...
strings.(고통을 호소하던 에코의 움직임이 멈춘다. 그리고 눈을 감은 채, 바이스: (Echo stops struggling in pain. With her eyes closed, she turns toward Weiss.)
strings.(%s의 시야로 어디선가 불어온 눈보라가 가득 채워진다. 그리고 그동안: (A blizzard fills %s's vision, gradually erasing the figures of Weiss and Echo.)
strings.(이런 말도 안되는 경우가… , 초인이라 불리는 사람들은 어째서 이런 일: (How can something so terrible happen...? Why do the people called Champions endure these things?)
%s, you're awake. Madeleine, put down that snowball.
...Being hit with a snowball hurts more than you'd think. Please don't do that too often.
It's over now. Some of that weight has lifted, too. Don't let it trouble you too much.
strings.다시 한 번 말하지만, 아버지와 아르고스 아저씨에겐 미안해도 명복 같은: I'll say it again. I'm sorry to my father and Uncle Argos, but I won't offer prayers for their souls. Even if they were victims...
strings.에코 같은 건 어차피 그런 운명이었으니 말할 가치도 없고, 죄값을 그렇게: Echo was headed for that fate anyway. She isn't worth discussing. She paid for her sins that way.
strings.나는 몰랐던 사실을 알게 된 것뿐이야. 이렇게 나에겐 바이스를 죽여야 할: I merely learned something I hadn't known. Now I have one more reason to kill Weiss, don't I?
strings.(이오가 많은 의미가 담긴 짧은 한숨을 내쉰다. 그러다 가볍게 웃으며 나: (Io lets out a short sigh carrying many meanings. Then she smiles faintly at Narin.)
strings.나린, 미안해. 물과 얼음의 정령은 전부 에코처럼 언니 같은 외모인줄 알: Narin, I'm sorry. I thought all water and ice spirits looked mature, like Echo.
Hehe. Such lovely words, you little wretch. Are you trying to freeze to death?
strings.얼어죽이는 건 나도 할 수 있어. 이래 보여도 초인이니까!: I can freeze people too! I'm a Champion, after all!
strings.나린, 마을에 오기 전에 무슨 일이 일어났는지 알게 됐는데 어때? 정령왕: Narin, now you know what happened before you came to the village. How do you feel? Spirit King...
strings.나린은 그러면 어떻게 되는 거에요?: What will happen to Narin now?
strings.별 일 없으면 그냥 우리 마을에서 계속 지내는 거지. 나린, 그럴 거지?: If nothing else happens, she'll keep living in our village. Right, Narin?
strings.%s 님, 저는 딱히 갈 곳도 없으니 이오 말처럼 게르다에 머문 채 살아: %s, I have nowhere else to go. As Io says, I will remain in Gerda.
A god brought me to this village, so here I shall stay.
strings.그리고 에코 덕분에 이 두루마리의 쓰임을 찾았으니, 앞으로 보탬이 되도록: And thanks to Echo, I have found this scroll's purpose. I shall put it to good use.
strings.에코 덕분이라…. 덕분은 덕분이네. 정령왕님이시니. 안 그래? 정령왕님?: Thanks to Echo... I suppose we do owe her that. You're a Spirit King, after all. Right, Your Majesty?
Show proper respect, Blizzard Empress. Come to think of it, we are both royalty. Hahaha.
Madeleine's right. Your jokes aren't very funny, Narin.
Thank you. You've given me faith.
strings.아니, 그런 건 아니고. 그러면 마을에 가서 이야기할까?: No, nothing like that. Shall we talk back in the village?
I'll make a round of the snowfields, then change shifts. I'm a little hungry.
strings.마들린, 아까 갈렛이 준 도시락은요?: Madeleine, what about the lunch Galette sent?
I ate it all while waiting for you three. Several hours have passed.
strings.이번엔 꽤 오래걸렸네. 짧은 순간일줄 알았는데. 일단, 돌아가자. 돌아가: It took quite a while this time. I thought it would be brief. Let's head back and talk there.
%s, let us return to the village.
strings.(나린이 갈렛에게 음식을 준비해달라고 부탁하러 가는 동안, 이오가 주위를: (While Narin goes to ask Galette to prepare food, Io looks around.)
strings.역시 나는 이곳을 포기할 수 없어. 나린이 에코처럼 한다면 분명 똑같이: I really can't give this place up. If Narin did what Echo did, I would do the same to her. She never would, of course, but if she did...
strings.그냥 혼잣말이니까 신경 쓰지 마. 아, %s, 네가 보지 못한 게 있었거: I'm only talking to myself. Don't mind me. Oh, %s, there was something you didn't see.
Echo's wing showed something only to Narin and me.
strings.내가 자기를 소멸시키길 바랐었나 봐. 하지만, 바이스가 그걸 허락하지 않: She seems to have wanted me to destroy her. But Weiss wouldn't allow it. He said Echo had to use all the binding power...
That must be something that will happen in Avalon.
I don't see anything. Just clouds...
strings.(돌아온 나린이 이오의 말을 듣자마자 고개를 끄덕인다. 잠시 후, 어디선: (Narin returns and nods at Io's words. A moment later, glittering ice crystals rise into the sky from somewhere.)
strings.얼음 결정에 불길한 기운이 묻을 거야. 봐, 이게 지금 어디로 가고 있는: The ominous energy will cling to the crystals. Watch where they're going...
They seem to be flying south. South would be...
strings.그래, 바이스가 있는 아발론이지. 대륙에 희미하게 남아있던 속박의 기운조: Yes. Avalon, where Weiss is. Even the faint traces of binding left across the continent are gathering in one place.
strings.그게 뭘 의미하는지 알겠어?: Do you know what that means?
Something big enough to require all that power. Bringing Deimos into this world.
strings.사실 이번에도 에코를 이용해 설원을 녹이고, 생명이 오염되면 속박의 힘으: He probably meant to use Echo to melt the snowfields this time, too. Once the living beings were contaminated, he'd convert them into binding power and take it.
I'm sorry I left my work to you again...
strings.하여튼, 속박의 힘을 떠안고 있던 에코가 소멸한 덕분에 샘이 간직한 정화: Anyway, with Echo and the binding power she carried gone, the spring's purifying energy is growing stronger.
strings.속박의 진실에 조금은 다가갔지만, 이걸로는 부족해. 그래서 난 이걸 더: I've come a little closer to the truth of binding, but this isn't enough. I'm going to develop it further.
strings.아르고스 아저씨의 정신이 잠시 돌아온 것처럼 단순히 속박을 푸는 것으로는: I don't think simply breaking the binding, as when Uncle Argos briefly regained his senses, will be enough...
strings.이오를 의심하지 마시지요. 허술해 보여도 정확하고 끈기가 있는 아이이옵니: Do not doubt Io. She may seem careless, but she is precise and persistent.
Narin, I'll ask the goddess to reassign you.
strings.(이오가 %s에게 중요한 이야기를 하려는 순간, 멀리 갈렛의 목소리가 들: (Just as Io is about to tell %s something important, Galette's voice comes from afar.)
strings.이오 님, 나린 님, %s 님, 식사 다 준비했어요. 오셔서 드시면 돼요: Lady Io, Lady Narin, %s! The food is ready! Come and eat!
strings.나린, %s!! 지금은 아무 생각하지 말고 먹고 쉬면서 복잡한 머릿속을: Narin, %s! For now, stop thinking. Let's eat, rest, and clear our crowded heads.
Yes. I was just getting hungry.
strings.(이오와 나린이 %s의 손을 잡고 맛있는 음식의 냄새가 나는 갈렛의 여관: (Io and Narin take %s by the hands and lead the adventurer toward the delicious smells from Galette's inn.)
strings.역시 설화의 음식은 최고야. 특별히 신의 모험가를 위해 새로운 음식을 만: Snowflower's food really is the best. I asked him to make something new especially for the gods' adventurer.
strings.잘 먹었습니다. 너무 맛있었어요. 그런데 궁금한 게 있어요. 나린이 정령: Thank you for the meal. It was delicious. But I'm curious: Narin is a spirit. How can she eat human food so well?
strings.이오의 양친께서 저를 거둬주시고, 그분께 은혜를 갚겠다고 생각한 순간부터: From the moment Io's parents took me in and I resolved to repay their kindness, I became able to eat like a human.
strings.…미르가 가끔 신기한 음식을 가져오는데 둘이 잘 먹더라고. 어떤 대륙의: ...Mir sometimes brings unusual food, and the two of them eat it happily. He says an elder spirit on another continent prepares food specially for spirits.
Enough of that. Let's discuss what remains.
strings.신의 힘에 연결된 '우리'는 그날이 오면 아발론으로 향할 거야. 그러기: 'We,' who are connected to divine power, will head to Avalon when that day comes. First, we'll need to tear open the boundary of binding that blocks it.
A kind of technique that allows the power of living beings to be formed elsewhere...
strings.오랜 연구 끝에 얼마 전에 알게 된 게 있어. 데이모스 교단과 가짜 아가: After long research, I learned something recently. While dismantling and combining magic stones made by the Deimos cult and the false Agasuras, I found something new...
The energy of destruction poured out.
strings.이 세계를 멸망시키려는 원초적 존재가 나타났던 고대 시절처럼 신들이 소멸: It felt as though gods were being annihilated, like in ancient times when the primordial being that sought this world's destruction appeared. As parts of my body began to split apart and vanish, Lady Gaia protected me.
strings.그게 이 세계를 멸망시키려는 원초적 존재가 가지고 있는 힘이란 걸 알려주: She told me it was the power of the primordial being that seeks to destroy this world...
I wanted to thank her, but I can hardly feel Lady Gaia anymore. That's never happened before...
Even when she slept, I could feel her presence in this world...
strings.어쨌든 연구가 좀 중단되긴 했지만, 다시 할 거야. 다시 멸망의 기운을: Anyway, the research stopped for a while, but I'll resume it. Even if I may encounter that destructive energy again...
strings.보다시피 난 괜찮아. 그리고 괜찮아야 해. 우리뿐만이 아니라 여신과 모두: As you can see, I'm fine. And I have to be. For the goddess and everyone, not only for us, I will never fall.
strings.고마워. 아, 그리고 모두 너에게만 맡기지 않을 거야. 그동안 준비한 게: Thank you. And I won't leave everything to you. I've been preparing things. Uncle's heart, freed from binding, should be a useful specimen too...
But when you say everyone, there's still...
Oh, don't worry about that. Miss Medea should be ready now.
strings.그야 메디아 양은 이오 언니를 좋아하니까. 이힛, 샤이닉 언니보다 날 더: After all, Medea likes her big sister Io. Hehe, I bet she likes me more than Shynic.
It seems only natural that she would prefer Io to that terrifying woman.
strings.나린 이야기는 못 들은 거로 하고, 며칠은 여기서 쉬다가 메디아 양을 만: Pretend you didn't hear Narin. Rest here for a few days, then go see Medea. You'll go in my name, so she'll welcome you.
The witch who interferes with us should also be away from Eastland for a while.
You know her. Daphne... The witches have been quiet, so I'm looking into it.
...She used to work so well with Weiss. Now she's just watching again.
That isn't what matters right now. Don't worry too much.
strings.아, 저는 이리스에게 돌아가서 여기 있었던 일을 이야기할게요. 그리고 이: Oh, I'll go back to Iris and tell her what happened here. Then I'll wait to hear from you.
All right. I'll call for you when the time comes, so come to Gerda. Huh...
Feta, what is it? If it's about magic, come another time.
strings.아니에요. 이오 님과 모험가님의 말씀이 끝나길 기다렸어요. 모험가님께 드: No. I was waiting for you and the adventurer to finish speaking. I have something to tell the adventurer.
strings.(엄청나게 큰 마법서…. 보통 마법사는 아닌 것 같은데….): (What an enormous spellbook... He doesn't seem like an ordinary mage...)
strings.잘은 모르겠지만, 별일이 아니길 바라야겠군요. 보통 이런 상황에서 %s: I don't know what it is, but I hope it isn't serious. In a situation like this, when someone has something to tell a person like %s... Hmm...
I'll hear what he has to say. Io, then I'll say goodbye here.
strings.그래. 알았어. 그러면 나중에 봐. 나린, %s에게 인사하고 가자. 페타: All right. See you later. Narin, say goodbye to %s and let's go. Feta, tell me about it later.
%s, take care, and please visit us again.
strings.자, 모험가님, 제가 있는 쪽으로 오시겠어요?: Now, Adventurer, would you come over here?
strings.(페타가 들고 있던 거대한 마법사를 바닥에 내려놓고 앉는다.): (Feta sets his enormous spellbook on the ground and sits.)
strings.이게 좀 무거워서 좀 내려둘게요. 모험가님도 여기 앉으시겠어요?: It's a little heavy, so I'll put it down. Would you like to sit too?
strings.저는 괜찮아요. 페타라고 했죠? 그런데 무슨 일이죠?: I'm fine. Your name was Feta, right? What is this about?
strings.(페타의 대답 대신 꼬르륵 소리가 들려온다. 패타의 뱃속에서 나는 소리: (Instead of an answer, a rumbling sound comes from what seems to be Feta's stomach.)
I'm still an inexperienced mage. I have to eat a lot to replenish my mana.
I am from the Silvaria Empire's Magic Bureau...
You're startled as soon as you hear the affiliation. The bureau's reputation really is terrible.
strings.저는 개인 자격으로 활동하는 견습 마법사에요. 특정 세력의 소속은 아니지: I'm an apprentice mage working independently. I don't belong to any particular faction, but I joined the Etoile Allied Forces because I wanted to try something different.
strings.루맨 같은 곳은 마법사가 많지만, 다른 곳에서는 수가 부족해서 특별히 연: Places like Lumen have plenty of mages, but other areas don't. So the allied forces sent me on a special assignment.
That's how I came to Gerda.
Though at the moment, I'm mostly just eating to replenish my mana.
strings.이오 님의 연구 중에 마력이 필요하면 원소마법을 대신 사용해 드리거나 간: When Lady Io's research needs mana, I cast elemental magic for her, or make simple magical tools for the villagers.
strings.루맨에서는 쥬얼 학파 마법사에게 빛을 잃은 보석에 마력을 불어넣기도 했어: In Lumen, I also put mana back into faded gems for the mages of the Jewel School.
strings.…그래서 제게 하고 싶은 말이 뭐죠? 이야기가 길어지는 걸 보니 진짜가: ...So what did you want to tell me? This long explanation makes me think there's something else.
strings.제가 말이 길었네요. 모험가님 하시는 말이 맞아요. 다른 이야기가 아니고: I've talked too much. You're right, Adventurer. What I actually meant...
strings.어떤 마녀에 대한 이야기에요. 마녀가 절 직접 찾아와 시종이 되겠냐고 했: It's about a certain witch. She came to me in person and asked if I'd become her servant. Inside the Silvaria Magic Bureau building, no less.
strings.마녀? 그리고 마법청이요?: A witch? In the Magic Bureau?
strings.놀라실만한 일 맞아요. 저도 놀랐으니까요. 왜 마법청에서…? 저는 마녀하: It's worth being surprised. I was surprised too. Why at the bureau...? I have nothing to do with witches...
strings.시종을 거절하니까 그 마녀가 %s 라는 이름을 가진 사람을 만날 일이 있: When I refused to serve her, she told me to give this to someone named %s if I ever met them.
She said she'd find and kill me if I didn't, so I've kept it all this time.
My life matters to me. Here, take it.
strings.(페타가 마법서 틈 사이에서 책갈피처럼 보이는 종이를 전달한다.): (Feta takes a slip of paper resembling a bookmark from between the pages of his spellbook.)
strings.저는 잘 모르겠어요. 때가 되면 그 사람은 그걸 가지고 누군가에게 찾아갈: I don't really know. She said that when the time came, that person would take it to someone.
strings.그 마녀, 어떻게 생겼나요?: What did the witch look like?
strings.분명 봤다고 생각했는데, 그 부분에 대해선 기억을 지운 것 같아요. 그곳: I thought I saw her clearly, but she seems to have erased that part of my memory. All I can remember is seeing someone called Zephyros there.
strings.저는 분명 전해드렸어요. 후우, 답답했던 게 내려가는 것 같네…. 아,: I've delivered it now. Whew, that weight seems to be lifting... Ah, she really must have put a curse on me.
strings.그 마녀, 진짜 날 죽이려고 했네…. 나는 죽지 않기 위해 그동안 먹었던: That witch really meant to kill me... I've been eating all this time to keep myself alive...
strings.저는 그러면 배가 고파서 이만…. 저주가 걸리든 말든 사람이라 그런지 배: Then I'll be going. I'm hungry... Cursed or not, I suppose a human still gets hungry. See you later, Adventurer.
strings.저 마법사의 말이 사실인가?: Is that mage telling the truth?
strings.기억을 지우는 마녀? 왜 이걸 나한테 준 거지…. 그리고 이 내용은…?: A witch who erases memories? Why did she give me this...? And what does it say...?
strings.(모험가가 들고 있는 종이엔 정성스러운 필기체로 다음과 같은 글이 적혀: (The paper in the adventurer's hand bears these words in careful cursive.)
strings.「누군가 오랫동안 기다리던 밤. 그 밤과 상관없이 다른 이가 기다리던 밤: "A night someone has awaited for a long time. Apart from that night, another will come that someone else has awaited. If you care for your god, stand with us at the end."
